calls.title: Joe Taylor and James Shannon
calls.summary: The meeting addressed the onboarding process for World Sports' Growth Book, highlighting the introduction of dedicated EMEA support with James Shannon in London to foster timely assistance. Most product teams have installed Growth Book SDKs, shifting the focus to increasing active usage and integrating experimentation into workflows. A cultural shift is prioritized to embed experimentation as a core practice, with a structured enablement program proposed to upskill senior product managers. The enterprise cloud license was confirmed to provide full support amidst concerns over open-source limitations. Initial efforts will target small groups of PMs to enhance engagement and drive organizational behavior change based on pragmatic experiences.
calls.keywords: Experimentation Culture, Enablement Sessions, Product Management, Feature Flagging, Enterprise Support, SDK Integration
